headline: Council adopts tax rates, approves housing grant bid, passes budget report

meeting.body: Maui County Council Notice of Public Hearing
meeting.voteItem: Amendment for a grant to conduct a community-focused feasibility study on Wailuku plantation parcels
meeting.summary: Council members adopted new real property tax rates nine to zero and approved a $1,932,564 federal housing grant application due June 2, 2026. They passed the budget committee report nine to zero and added conditions to a temple grant, also nine to zero.
meeting.recap: Two council members joined from Japan, where it was 5 a.m.[[0:01:24]] The Department of Housing asked the council to approve a $1,932,564 federal grant application before a June 2, 2026 deadline.[[0:20:44]] The council adopted the new real property tax rates by a vote of nine to zero.[[1:50:01]] The council approved the federal housing grant application.[[1:52:37]] The council voted five to four to reserve part of some mayor's office budgets during the election year.[[2:22:23]] A motion to drop fees at county electric vehicle charging stations failed, four to five.[[2:40:40]] To match the lower tax rates, a council member moved to cut $218,086, including $110,000 from a Scouting America grant.[[2:47:39]] A council member moved to add conditions to the temple grant, including following shoreline rules.[[3:53:58]] The conditions passed nine to zero.[[4:07:59]] Council members reconsidered and withdrew changes to an upcountry wildfire recovery program.[[4:48:05]] The council accepted up to $300,000 in donated labor from Goodfellow Brothers for playground equipment at Kīlauea Mauka Park.[[4:51:55]] The council passed the budget committee report, nine to zero.[[5:06:24]]
decided: The amendment for up to $250,000 for a community feasibility study on Wailuku plantation parcels passed.
Conditions were added to the Pāʻia temple grant.
The council voted to reconsider the upcountry recovery program changes, which were then withdrawn.
meeting.next: An engineer for the temple project said they will remove the gravel the county objected to. The vice chair will review the upcountry recovery plan with John Smith and bring a revised version at second reading. The vice chair said her office has already asked to meet with John Smith.

moments.q: "We have two of our members in Japan. It is 5 a.m. over there."
"So the question is, how will this 2.5 million be used?"
Final vote on the budget committee report

issues.oneLine: The county is applying for $1,932,564 in federal Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) money for program year 2026.
issues.why: A housing official said the projects support low and moderate income residents.

deadlines.t: HUD annual action plan submission deadline for the grant application.

issues.next: The program manager said the application must reach HUD by June 2nd.
issues.brief: The money would support rental housing for kūpuna and repairs to emergency and transitional housing.[[#1]] A housing official said the $845,051 for one rehabilitation project covers some, but not all, of its funding gap.[[#2]] The council amended the budget to list each grant project by name, eight to zero with one excused.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: The council changed agricultural microgrant rules to favor farmers carrying out the Maui County Food and Nutrition Security Plan 2025–2030.
issues.why: The animal feed pilot is meant to support locally grown, drought-tolerant feed for livestock producers during drought periods.
issues.brief: No more than 10% of each microgrant may be used for fencing.[[#1]] Each animal feed pilot grantee may receive up to $100,000.[[#2]] Feed pilot applicants must run a ranching business on 40 usable acres or more in Maui County.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: The budget sets aside up to $3 million for an upcountry wildfire rebuild, recovery and mitigation program.
issues.why: The vice chair said residents at community meetings describe needs greater than $50,000 per household.
issues.next: The vice chair will review the plan with John Smith and bring a revised version at second reading.
issues.brief: The plan describes help for upcountry residents who are on a fixed income, uninsured, or underinsured.[[#1]] The vice chair said a philanthropic partner may cover the program's administrative costs.[[#2]] Changes to the program made earlier in the day were reconsidered and withdrawn.[[#3]]
